title: Sarvam becomes India’s newest AI unicorn with $234 million funding round led by HCLTech
brief: Sarvam AI, a Bengaluru-based startup, has achieved unicorn status with a $234 million funding round led by HCLTech, which is investing $150 million. The round underscores India's growing position in the AI ecosystem and HCLTech's commitment to building AI capabilities.
